ORDER

The Public Utilities Commission of Nevada (“Commission”) makes the following
findings of fact and conclusions of law:
I. INTRODUCTION

CenturyTel of the Gem State, Inc. d/b/a CenturyLink (“CenturyLink”) filed with the
Commission an application under Advice Letter No. NV2026-04, designated as Docket No. 26-
05010, to revise Tariff No. 1A to grandfather Key System Lines, PBX Trunk Lines, and Payphone
Services.
I. SUMMARY

The Commission grants the application and approves the revised tariff.
Til. PROCEDURAL HISTORY
* On May 11, 2026, CenturyLink filed its application in accordance with the Nevada Revised
Statutes (“NRS”) and the Nevada Administrative Code (“NAC”) Chapters 703 and 704,
including, but not limited to, NRS 704.100, and NAC 703.400.

* The Regulatory Operations Staff of the Commission (“Staff”) participates as a matter of right
pursuant to NRS 703.301.

* On May 26, 2026, the Commission issued a Notice of Application to Revise Tariff.

* On June 25, 2026, Staff filed a briefing memorandum (“Staff's Briefing Memorandum”).

Docket No. 26-05010 Page 2

* On June 30, 2026, the Commission voted to adopt the recommendations contained in Staff's
Briefing Memorandum.

IV. APPLICATION
CenturyLink’s Request

1, CenturyLink seeks approval to revise Tariff No. 1A to grandfather Key System
Lines, PBX Trunk Lines, and Payphone Services. (Application at 1.)
Staffs Position

2. Staff reviewed the application and recommends that the Commission issue an
order granting the application and approving the revised tariff, effective July 1, 2026. (Staffs
Briefing Memorandum at 2.)
Commission Discussion and Findings

3. The Commission adopts the analysis and recommendations in Staffs Briefing
Memorandum. Accordingly, the Commission grants CenturyLink’s application and approves the
revisions to CenturyLink’s Tariff No. 1A to grandfather Key System Lines, PBX Trunk Lines,
and Payphone Services, effective July 1, 2026.

Therefore, it is ordered:

1. CenturyTel of the Gem State, Inc. d/b/a CenturyLink’s application filed under
Advice Letter No. NV2026-04, designated as Docket No. 26-05010, is granted.
